build_quantized_linear_layer_mlx: build a QuantLinearMLX module with 4-bit quantization and group size 128 for Apple Silicon inference
convert_gptq_to_mlx_format: convert a GPTQ quantized linear module to MLX format using QuantLinearMLX.from_gptq for hardware accelerated inference
run_quantized_forward_pass: run a forward pass through a QuantLinearMLX layer that uses MLX quantized_matmul or falls back to PyTorch
unpack_packed_weight_tensor: unpack a uint32 packed weight tensor from a QuantLinearMLX layer back to integer values using _unpack_weight_torch
convert_torch_tensor_to_mlx: convert a PyTorch tensor to an MLX array using _torch_to_mlx with DLPack zero-copy transfer
